flaggedIssues.description: High CHA2DS2-VASc score (9 of 9) — oral anticoagulation is recommended unless contraindicated
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Offer oral anticoagulation (DOAC preferred, or warfarin with good time-in-therapeutic-range) as part of shared decision-making.

flaggedIssues.description: High stroke risk that may be untreated — no anticoagulation decision is recorded on this assessment

flaggedIssues.description: Before starting anticoagulation, weigh stroke risk against bleeding risk
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Complete a HAS-BLED assessment and correct modifiable bleeding risks; a high HAS-BLED score is not by itself a reason to withhold anticoagulation.

flaggedIssues.description: Prior stroke, TIA, or thromboembolism — the strongest single risk factor (2 points)
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Secondary prevention is indicated; ensure anticoagulation is addressed unless contraindicated.
